component.name: ParticipantButton
component.description: Opens the participant list and shows a live participant count. The desktop panel can be dragged by its header. On desktop, the panel closes only when you click the button again or use the panel's close button. On mobile, the list opens in a bottom sheet.

props.name: renderContent
props.description: Render a custom icon in place of the default participants icon. The count badge is still shown.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the panel closes, including when the mobile sheet is dismissed. On desktop, the panel closes only when you click the button again or use the panel's close button.

props.name: isMobile
props.description: Shows the participant list in a mobile bottom sheet instead of the desktop panel. Not detected automatically. The sheet closes when you swipe it down, tap outside it, or use its close button.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Anchors the desktop panel to this element instead of the button. Pass an HTML element or any object with getBoundingClientRect(). Ignored on mobile.

props.name: popoverProps
props.description: Initial position of the desktop panel: side, align, sideOffset, alignOffset, and collisionPadding. By default the panel opens above the button, aligned to its start edge, and moves to the opposite side when there isn't enough room. Ignored on mobile.

props.name: panelClassName
props.description: Additional CSS class for the desktop participant panel.

props.name: panelStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the desktop participant panel.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the button.

notes: Each row shows the participant's avatar, name, role (Host or Manager), '(me)' for you, and audio, video, and screen-share status, plus the actions your role allows. Active speakers are highlighted. Participants without a name are shown as 'Guest'.

Hosts can rename, mute, ask to unmute, change roles, and remove participants. Co-hosts can rename, mute, ask to unmute, and remove participants who are not hosts or co-hosts, and can also mute other co-hosts.
The panel also includes search, a Mute All button for hosts and co-hosts, and a Reclaim host button when you are eligible.
To place the participant list in your own layout, render ParticipantPanel directly.
behavior: Disabled unless the session is connected.
Shows a count badge when participants are present. Counts above 99 show as 99+.
The desktop panel opens above the button by default (change this with popoverProps), stays within the viewport, and can be dragged by its header.
aria-expanded and aria-haspopup='dialog' are set automatically.

types.name: ParticipantButtonPopoverProps
types.description: Initial placement of the desktop participant panel.

fields.name: side
fields.description: Preferred side of the button or anchor. Moves to the opposite side when there isn't enough room.

fields.name: sideOffset
fields.description: Distance from the button or anchor, in pixels.

fields.name: alignOffset
fields.description: Offset from the chosen alignment, in pixels.

fields.name: collisionPadding
fields.description: Minimum gap kept from the viewport edges, in pixels.

types.name: VirtualElement
types.description: Not exported by name. Pass an HTML element, or any object with a getBoundingClientRect() method that returns a DOMRect.

fields.name: getBoundingClientRect
fields.description: Returns the position and size to anchor to.

actionVisibilityRules.description: Available participant actions depend on your role, the selected participant, and session permissions. Manager means co-host. The action menu is hidden when no actions are available.
actionVisibilityRules.orderNote: Rename is first and Remove is last when those actions are available; desktop and mobile use the same ordering.

rules.shownWhen: For your own name when renaming is allowed. Hosts can rename other participants; co-hosts can rename participants who are neither hosts nor co-hosts.
For any participant who has joined audio and is unmuted. You can always mute yourself; hosts and co-hosts can also mute other participants except the host.
For a muted participant who has joined audio. Hosts can ask any other participant; co-hosts can ask participants who are neither hosts nor co-hosts.
For another participant when you are the current host.
For a participant who is neither host nor co-host, when you are the current host.
For a co-host when you are the current host.
Hosts can remove other participants. Co-hosts can remove participants who are neither hosts nor co-hosts.

notes: Other participants cannot moderate the host.
Only the host can transfer the host role, assign co-hosts, or remove co-host privileges.
Co-hosts can mute other co-hosts, but cannot rename them, remove them, or ask them to unmute.
Ask to unmute sends a request that the participant can accept or decline.
Make Host opens a 'Change host to <name>' confirmation with Cancel and Change host buttons. The dialog notes: "You can't assign co-owner access to Zoom Room or users from different accounts."
